cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you're behind me. Come to my opening night instead of the prize ceremony; I'll reserve your front seat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm receiving the prize. I can't just disappear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can send apologies. That's a withdrawal, not a disappearance; I can help you word it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll come tomorrow and see the same show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow isn't opening night. Send your apologies now, please; I need to know whether to hold your seat tonight.

reason: Make the claimed support explicit and leave A demanding the costly date; remove prior-commitment assertion and cost-test explanation.
